1.english_reference: And Satan stood up against Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲמֹ֥ד שָׂטָ֖ן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔστη διάβολος ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Consurréxit autem Satan contra Israel :
traditions.KJV: And Satan stood up against Israel ,

1.english_reference: and provoked David to number Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨סֶת֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔יד לִ מְנ֖וֹת אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέσεισεν τὸν Δαυεὶδ τοῦ ἀριθμῆσαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et concitávit David ut numeráret Israel .
traditions.KJV: and provoked David to number Israel .

2.english_reference: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד אֶל יוֹאָב֙ וְ אֶל שָׂרֵ֣י הָ עָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυεὶδ πρὸς Ἰωὰβ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως
traditions.VUL: Dixítque David ad Ioab , et ad príncipes pópuli :
traditions.KJV: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people ,

2.english_reference: Go , number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan

traditions.WLC: לְכ֗וּ סִפְרוּ֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וְ עַד דָּ֑ן
traditions.LXX: Πορεύθητε δὴ ἀριθμήσατε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ Βηρσάβεε καὶ ἕως Δάν ,
traditions.VUL: Ite , et numeráte Israel a Bersabée usque Dan :
traditions.KJV: Go , number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan ;

2.english_reference: and bring the number of them to me , that I may know [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ הָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔ י וְ אֵדְעָ֖ה אֶת מִסְפָּרָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνέγκατε πρὸς μέ , καὶ γνώσομαι τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et afférte mihi númerum ut sciam .
traditions.KJV: and bring the number of them to me , that I may know [ it ] .

3.english_reference: And Joab answered , The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they [ be ]

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֗ב יוֹסֵף֩ יְהוָ֨ה עַל עַמּ֤ וֹ כָּ הֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωάβ Προσθείη Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὡς αὐτοὶ ἑκατονταπλασίως ,
traditions.VUL: Respondítque Ioab : Augeat Dóminus pópulum suum céntuplum , quam sunt :
traditions.KJV: And Joab answered , The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they [ be ] :

3.english_reference: but , my lord the king , [ are ] they not all my lord ’s servants ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹא֙ אֲדֹנִ֣ י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ כֻּלָּ֥ ם לַ אדֹנִ֖ י לַ עֲבָדִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως βλέποντες · πάντες τῷ κυρίῳ μου παῖδες ·
traditions.VUL: nonne dómine mi rex , omnes servi tui sunt ?
traditions.KJV: but , my lord the king , [ are ] they not all my lord ’s servants ?

3.english_reference: why then doth my lord require this thing ?

traditions.WLC: לָ֣ מָּה יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ זֹאת֙ אֲדֹנִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: ἵνα τί ζητεῖ κύριός μου τοῦτο ;
traditions.VUL: quare hoc quærit dóminus meus ,
traditions.KJV: why then doth my lord require this thing ?

3.english_reference: why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?

traditions.WLC: לָ֛ מָּה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ אַשְׁמָ֖ה לְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἵνα μὴ γένηται εἰς ἁμαρτίαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: quod in peccátum reputétur Israéli ?
traditions.KJV: why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?

4.english_reference: Nevertheless the king ’s word prevailed against Joab

traditions.WLC: וּ דְבַר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָזַ֣ק עַל יוֹאָ֑ב
traditions.VUL: Sed sermo regis magis præváluit :
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless the king ’s word prevailed against Joab .

4.english_reference: Wherefore Joab departed , and went throughout all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֣א יוֹאָ֗ב וַ יִּתְהַלֵּךְ֙ בְּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.VUL: egressúsque est Ioab , et circuívit univérsum Israel :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore Joab departed , and went throughout all Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et revérsus est Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and came to Jerusalem .

5.english_reference: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד הָ עָ֖ם אֶל דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν Ἰωὰβ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῆς ἐπισκέψεως τοῦ λαοῦ τῷ Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: dedítque David númerum eórum , quos circuíerat :
traditions.KJV: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David .

5.english_reference: And all [ they of ] Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִים֩ וּ מֵאָ֨ה אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ χίλιαι χιλιάδες καὶ ἑκατὸν χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν ἐσπασμένων μάχαιραν .
traditions.VUL: et invéntus est omnis númerus Israel , mille míllia et centum míllia virórum educéntium gládium :
traditions.KJV: And all [ they of ] Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword :

5.english_reference: and Judah [ was ] four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword

traditions.WLC: וִֽ יהוּדָ֕ה אַרְבַּע֩ מֵא֨וֹת וְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב
traditions.VUL: de Iuda autem quadringénta septuagínta míllia bellatórum .
traditions.KJV: and Judah [ was ] four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .

6.english_reference: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them

traditions.WLC: וְ לֵוִי֙ וּ בִנְיָמִ֔ן לֹ֥א פָקַ֖ד בְּ תוֹכָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν Λευεὶ καὶ τὸν Βενιαμεὶν οὐκ ἠρίθμησεν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Nam Levi , et Béniamin non numerávit :
traditions.KJV: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them :

6.english_reference: for the king ’s word was abominable to Joab

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נִתְעַ֥ב דְּבַר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת יוֹאָֽב
traditions.LXX: ὅτι κατίσχυσεν λόγος τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν Ἰωάβ .
traditions.VUL: eo quod Ioab invítus exsequerétur regis impérium .
traditions.KJV: for the king ’s word was abominable to Joab .

7.english_reference: And God was displeased with this thing

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֨רַע֙ בְּ עֵינֵ֣י הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל הַ דָּבָ֖ר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ τοῦ πράγματος τούτου ,
traditions.VUL: Displícuit autem Deo quod iussum erat :
traditions.KJV: And God was displeased with this thing ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֖ךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et percússit Israel .
traditions.KJV: therefore he smote Israel .

8.english_reference: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ אֶל הָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים חָטָ֣אתִֽי מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי אֶת הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ πρὸς τὸν θεόν Ἡμάρτηκα σφόδρα ὅτι ἐποίησα τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο ·
traditions.VUL: Dixítque David ad Deum : Peccávi nimis ut hoc fácerem :
traditions.KJV: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing :

8.english_reference: but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה הַֽעֲבֶר נָא֙ אֶת עֲו֣וֹן עַבְדְּ ךָ֔
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν περίελε δὴ τὴν κακίαν παιδός σου ,
traditions.VUL: óbsecro , aufer iniquitátem servi tui ,
traditions.KJV: but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant ;

8.english_reference: for I have done very foolishly

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐματαιώθην σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: quia insipiénter egi .
traditions.KJV: for I have done very foolishly .

9.english_reference: And the LORD spake unto Gad , David ’s seer , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל גָּ֔ד חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖יד לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος πρὸς Γὰδ ὁρῶντα .
traditions.VUL: Et locútus est Dóminus ad Gad Vidéntem Davídis , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Gad , David ’s seer , saying ,

10.english_reference: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: לֵךְ֩ וְ דִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶל דָּוִ֜יד לֵ אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Πορεύου καὶ λάλησον πρὸς Δαυεὶδ λέγων Οὕτως λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Vade , et lóquere ad David , et dic ei : Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: שָׁל֕וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י נֹטֶ֣ה עָלֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Τρία αἴρω ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ ·
traditions.VUL: Trium tibi optiónem do :
traditions.KJV: I offer thee three [ things ] :

10.english_reference: choose thee one of them , that I may do [ it ] unto thee

traditions.WLC: בְּחַר לְ ךָ֛ אַחַ֥ת מֵ הֵ֖נָּה וְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ποιήσω σοι .
traditions.VUL: unum , quod volúeris , élige , et fáciam tibi .
traditions.KJV: choose thee one of them , that I may do [ it ] unto thee .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥בֹא גָ֖ד אֶל דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν Γὰδ πρὸς Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset Gad ad David ,
traditions.KJV: So Gad came to David ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: dixit ei :
traditions.KJV: and said unto him ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: קַבֶּל לָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: Ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ .
traditions.VUL: Elige quod volúeris :
traditions.KJV: Choose thee

traditions.WLC: אִם שָׁל֨וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֜ים רָעָ֗ב
traditions.LXX: ἢ τρία ἔτη λιμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: aut tribus annis famem :
traditions.KJV: Either three years ’ famine ;

12.english_reference: or three months to be destroyed before thy foes

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה חֳדָשִׁ֜ים נִסְפֶּ֥ה מִ פְּנֵי צָרֶי ךָ֮
traditions.LXX: ἢ τρεῖς μῆνας φεύγειν σε ἐκ προσώπου ἐχθρῶν σου ,
traditions.VUL: aut tribus ménsibus te fúgere hostes tuos ,
traditions.KJV: or three months to be destroyed before thy foes ,

12.english_reference: while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh [ thee ]

traditions.WLC: וְ חֶ֣רֶב אוֹיְבֶ֣ ךָ לְ מַשֶּׂגֶת֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ μάχαιρα ἐξ ἐχθρῶν σου τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ,
traditions.VUL: et gládium eórum non posse evádere :
traditions.KJV: while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh [ thee ] ;

12.english_reference: or else three days the sword of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָ֠מִים חֶ֣רֶב יְהוָ֤ה
traditions.LXX: ἢ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ῥομφαίαν Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: aut tribus diébus gládium Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: or else three days the sword of the LORD ,

12.english_reference: even the pestilence , in the land

traditions.WLC: וְ דֶ֨בֶר֙ בָּ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ θάνατον ἐν τῇ γῇ ,
traditions.VUL: et pestiléntiam versári in terra ,
traditions.KJV: even the pestilence , in the land ,

12.english_reference: and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel

traditions.WLC: וּ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מַשְׁחִ֖ית בְּ כָל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἐξολεθρεύων ἐν πάσῃ κληρονομίᾳ Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: et ángelum Dómini interfícere in univérsis fínibus Israel :
traditions.KJV: and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel .

12.english_reference: Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה רְאֵ֔ה מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת שֹׁלְחִ֖ י דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἴδε τί ἀποκριθῶ τῷ ἀποστείλαντι λόγον .
traditions.VUL: nunc ígitur vide quid respóndeam ei , qui misit me .
traditions.KJV: Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛יד אֶל גָּ֖ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ πρὸς Γάδ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit David ad Gad :
traditions.KJV: And David said unto Gad ,

13.english_reference: I am in a great strait

traditions.WLC: צַר לִ֣ י מְאֹ֑ד
traditions.LXX: Στενά μοι καὶ τὰ τρία σφόδρα ·
traditions.VUL: Ex omni parte me angústiæ premunt :
traditions.KJV: I am in a great strait :

13.english_reference: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֶפְּלָה נָּ֣א בְ יַד יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ἐμπεσοῦμαι δὴ εἰς χεῖρας Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: sed mélius mihi est ut íncidam in manus Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD ;

13.english_reference: for very great [ are ] his mercies

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי רַבִּ֤ים רַחֲמָי ו֙ מְאֹ֔ד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ οἰκτειρμοὶ αὐτοῦ σφόδρα ,
traditions.VUL: quia multæ sunt miseratiónes eius ,
traditions.KJV: for very great [ are ] his mercies :

13.english_reference: but let me not fall into the hand of man

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ יַד אָדָ֖ם אַל אֶפֹּֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων οὐ μὴ ἐμπέσω .
traditions.VUL: quam in manus hóminum .
traditions.KJV: but let me not fall into the hand of man .

14.english_reference: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה דֶּ֖בֶר בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν Κύριος θάνατον ἐν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Misit ergo Dóminus pestiléntiam in Israel :
traditions.KJV: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel :

14.english_reference: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפֹּל֙ מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔπεσον ἐξ Ἰσραὴλ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν .
traditions.VUL: et cecidérunt de Israel septuagínta míllia virórum .
traditions.KJV: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .

15.english_reference: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַח֩ הָ אֱלֹהִ֨ים מַלְאָ֥ךְ לִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַם֮ לְ הַשְׁחִיתָ הּ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς ἄγγελον εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: Misit quoque ángelum in Ierúsalem , ut percúteret eam :
traditions.KJV: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it :

15.english_reference: and as he was destroying , the LORD beheld , and he repented him of the evil

traditions.WLC: וּ כְ הַשְׁחִ֗ית רָאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וַ יִּנָּ֣חֶם עַל הָֽ רָעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς ἐξολόθρευεν , εἶδεν Κύριος καὶ μετεμελήθη ἐπὶ τῇ κακίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: cumque percuterétur , vidit Dóminus , et misértus est super magnitúdine mali :
traditions.KJV: and as he was destroying , the LORD beheld , and he repented him of the evil ,

15.english_reference: and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand
